_doc: How the system should behave for you. Edit freely.
tone: warm, direct, no hype, no guilt

discovery_formats._doc: Rules for Daily Discovery and Shorts (validation enforces the 'required' ones).
discovery_formats.required: every day: at least one podcast episode and at least one video, lecture or documentary; at least one item in each tier (established, growth, exploration). The rest is free: entertainment, free-time interests, reads, no fixed number
discovery_formats.shorts: 30 to 40 videos a day, at least one in each tier
discovery_formats.podcasts: link to the specific episode page, not the show; add audio_url (the episode's audio file from the show's RSS feed) when you have it, so it plays on the page
discovery_formats.videos: verified links; YouTube IDs confirmed via oEmbed or the API

monthly.max_scope: one month; split anything larger into a one-month milestone

difficulty.math: graduate level is fine; give progressive hints rather than solutions
difficulty.physics: comfortable with undergraduate math; build intuition first
difficulty.humanities: curious beginner, prefers stories and primary sources

media.anime: open to classics and thoughtful series
media.books: both fiction and non-fiction; prefers books that change how you see things
